---
title: "bubble plot"
author: "Zhao2026"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggnewscale)

csv_file <- file.choose()
setwd(dirname(csv_file))

data <- read.csv("bubble_plot.csv", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

# Label and value transformation
data$BP_Label <- paste(data$BP_Category, data$`function`, sep = " | ")
data$Pvalue <- -log10(data$Pvalue)

# Maintain original row order as Y-axis order
y_order <- unique(data$BP_Label)
data$BP_Label <- factor(data$BP_Label, levels = y_order)
data$BP_Category <- factor(data$BP_Category, levels = unique(data$BP_Category))

# Split by fold change direction
data_up   <- data[data$FC == "up", ]
data_down <- data[data$FC == "down", ]

# Color scales
red_colors  <- colorRampPalette(c("#FB9092", "#970526"))
blue_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#96C0FB", "#1D4ECC"))
pval_limits <- range(data$Pvalue, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data_up,
             aes(x = Comparison_Groups, y = BP_Label, size = Count, color = Pvalue),
             alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    name   = "Increased\n-Log(Pvalue)",
    colors = red_colors(100),
    limits = pval_limits
  ) +
  new_scale_color() +
  geom_point(data = data_down,
             aes(x = Comparison_Groups, y = BP_Label, size = Count, color = Pvalue),
             alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    name   = "Decreased\n-Log(Pvalue)",
    colors = blue_colors(100),
    limits = pval_limits
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 6)) +
  labs(size = "Count", x = "", y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = y_order, position = "right")

```
